narration.text: Still manually editing product review videos for 20 minutes each?
First, let's talk speed. Pictory generates a 5-minute video in just 10 minutes, a real time saver! InVideo, however, takes a much longer 28 minutes for the same task. Pictory wins this round easily!

Now, for the review quality. Pictory offers a clear voice and decent b-roll, but the output feels a bit basic. InVideo, on the other hand, delivers more dynamic visuals and a more engaging, polished final product. InVideo takes this round!
So, Pictory wins for sheer speed, ideal for high-volume, basic reviews. InVideo offers a more polished, engaging final product for premium content. Which one would you pick?
